gaps.lead: He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: couldn't = was not able to (general ability in the past).

gaps.lead: 'I'm sorry I was so rude to your sister,' Maria said.
gaps.sentence: Maria apologised ___ so rude to my sister.
gaps.explanation: apologise for + -ing: apologised for being so rude.

gaps.answer: sure how I would have reacted
gaps.lead: It's difficult to know what my reaction would have been in that situation.
gaps.hint: difficult to know = not sure how
gaps.explanation: 'I'm not sure how I would have reacted' — a hypothetical past.

gaps.lead: The company is unable to guarantee an allocated car-parking space to all employees.
gaps.sentence: The company's employees shouldn't ___ allocated a car-parking space.
gaps.explanation: 'Count on being allocated' means rely on receiving.

gaps.lead: 'Could you open the window, please?' she asked me.
He spoke slowly because he wanted us to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so that + subject + would/could expresses purpose.
